content.text: Digital creators around the world are facing significant payment processing restrictions, particularly in regions where platforms like PayPal and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-honest-side-side-breakdown-20|stripe]] are either unavailable or impose heavy fees. This is especially true for creators in countries such as Nigeria, Venezuela, and Zimbabwe, where economic conditions make traditional payment solutions ineffective. This post breaks down how crypto payment gateways can serve as a robust alternative for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-fonts-online-without-paypal-which-architecture-actually-12|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-stock-photos-without-paypal-honest-side-side-14|Selling Stock]] digital products, from ebooks to templates, without the crippling costs of conventional platforms.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-explained-digital-creators-6. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

A crypto payment gateway is a service that facilitates the acceptance of cryptocurrency as a form of payment for digital products. Unlike traditional payment processors that often charge high fees—like Gumroad, which takes 10% on every sale—crypto gateways like NOWPayments charge a mere 0.5%. This difference can be substantial; for example, if you sell a $97 product and make 100 sales in a month, you would save $921 in fees by using NOWPayments. This model not only reduces costs but also empowers creators with complete ownership of their transactions and products, removing dependencies on restrictive platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure for deploying a sovereign crypto payment solution consists of various free tools that work together seamlessly. At the core is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, where your digital products are displayed. For backend operations, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle the logic, including payment verification via NOWPayments. Once a payment is confirmed on-chain, products are delivered automatically through tools like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This architecture not only ensures fast and reliable service but also guarantees that you maintain complete ownership over your data and sales.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where access to conventional payment systems is severely limited. Whether you are an author selling ebooks, an educator offering online courses, or a designer selling templates and fonts, this solution is tailored for you. By leveraging crypto payment gateways, you can effectively reach a global audience without the burden of high fees or restrictive policies that traditional platforms impose. This is a game-changer for creators who value ownership and autonomy in their business operations.
NOWPayments charges just 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than conventional platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effective deployment of a crypto payment gateway involves a combination of components that work in unison. The front end consists of a user-friendly site built on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. The backend relies on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for managing transactions and order fulfillment. Data storage is handled through Supabase or Google Sheets, ensuring easy access and management of orders. Products are stored and delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, NOWPayments integrates with the system for accepting various cryptocurrencies, ensuring seamless transactions and eliminating the need for customer accounts.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own crypto payment gateway, start by setting up a GitHub or Cloudflare Pages account to host your site. Next, create products and upload them to a file delivery service like Google Drive. Utilize Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle payment processing and delivery logic. Integrate NOWPayments to manage cryptocurrency transactions. Finally, test the entire system to ensure smooth operation before going live. For a comprehensive guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints plus templates to streamline your deployment process.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing a crypto payment gateway like NOWPayments. This service allows you to accept cryptocurrency directly, eliminating the need for traditional payment processors. By doing this, you maintain full control over your sales and avoid hefty fees associated with platforms like Gumroad.
Complete ownership of your digital products means no one can take your revenue away.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're exploring ways to sell digital downloads without platform fees, our Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers everything you need to create a sovereign stack. You can find it at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, providing tools and blueprints to set up your own payment and delivery system.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

You can sell an ebook by utilizing a crypto payment gateway like NOWPayments. This method allows you to accept various cryptocurrencies directly, bypassing traditional payment processors.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?
The best way is to create your own infrastructure using free tools like GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing, drastically reducing costs.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by setting up your own store using a crypto payment gateway. This ensures you retain full ownership and avoid high fees.
What tools do I need to set up a crypto payment gateway?
You'll need a hosting service like GitHub Pages, a backend script like Google Apps Script, a file delivery service like Google Drive, and NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency payments.
How do I ensure secure transactions when selling digital products?
Using reputable services like NOWPayments ensures secure transactions. Additionally, deploying your system on reliable platforms like Cloudflare enhances security through their infrastructure.
